verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document live-call monitoring in production or alerting when agents misbehave or error rates spike. Post-call webhooks fire only after a call completes. Evals grade call quality with LLM judges, and the MCP server can query analytics. These are adjacent building blocks a user could wire into their own alerting, not a native monitoring and alerting capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike
